g.text: Client demand and consumer AI (c): applications and seats
Box: a stock. Hourglass: a flow (its valve), named below. Bold coloured text: an
auxiliary. Thick arrow: a flow changing the stock it points to. Thin arrow: an
input of the item it points to. Grey text, (module): an input from another
module. Dashed grey box, (page): an input from another page of this module.
Arrows show dependence only and carry no polarity: signs are on the causal-loop
Goal-seeking valves (a stock adjusting toward a target; every input points at
